events.title: Events

events.sessionsHint: Enter local times at the venue ({{tz}}). Guests check in at one session only.
events.checkInHere: Guests check in at this session
events.confirmCancel: Cancel this event? Payments already made are not refunded.
events.noStaff: No Staff yet. Invite Staff first under
events.staffHint: Only the selected Staff can scan check-ins for this event.
events.newSubtitle: Enter the name and schedule; add guests afterwards.
events.descriptionHint: Shown as the story on the invitation page.

staffArea.title: My events
staffArea.empty: You aren't assigned to any event yet.

packages.chooseHint: Choose a package to activate the event. Invitations, RSVP and check-in work once the payment succeeds.
packages.changeHint: Want another package? Pick it below; the unfinished payment is replaced.
packages.ownerPays: The Owner chooses a package and pays to activate this event.

feature.guestPhotos: Guests can take photos ({{n}} per invitation)

payments.title: Payment
payments.pendingNotice: The payment for the {{name}} package isn't finished yet.
payments.waiting: Waiting for the payment to be confirmed. This page updates by itself.
payments.paidMessage: Payment received. Your event is now active.

closed.Failed: The payment failed. Go back to the event to try again.
closed.Expired: The time to pay has passed. Go back to the event to start a new payment.
closed.Cancelled: This payment was cancelled: another payment replaced it, or the event was cancelled.

payments.simulateHint: No payment gateway is connected. Choose an outcome to try the flow.
payments.receiptFootnote: This receipt is proof of payment, not a tax invoice.

guests.title: Guests & invitations
guests.entryHint: Guest list, invitation links, QR codes and Send via WhatsApp.
guests.full: The package's guest limit is reached (it counts people; a group counts every member).
guests.notActiveYet: You can prepare the guest list now. Invitation links, QR codes and the WhatsApp button appear once the event is paid (active).
guests.empty: No guests yet. Add a guest to create their invitation link and QR code.
guests.name: Guest name
guests.nameHint: The name shown on the invitation, for example "Mr & Mrs Andi" or "The Wijaya family".
guests.phoneHint: For the Send via WhatsApp button. Example: 0812 3456 7890.
guests.peopleHint: Only the number, no member names (2–50).
guests.revokedHint: The old link and QR code no longer work. Generate a new code to activate it again.
guests.confirmRegenerate: Generate a new code? Links and QR codes already sent will stop working.
guests.confirmRevoke: Revoke this invitation? Its link and QR code stop working at once.
guests.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Their invitation is revoked too.
guests.templateHint: Use {nama} (name), {acara} (event) and {link}. {link} is required: it's where the guest's invitation link goes.
guests.sendAfterPayment: Can be sent once the event is paid
guests.sendAfterPaymentHint: The invitation is ready. The link, QR code and Send via WhatsApp become available once the event is paid.
guests.importHint: Columns: nama/name (required), telepon/phone, email, jumlah/people (more than 1 = group). Names and WhatsApp numbers must not repeat another guest of this event. Guests are invited to every session. If any row is wrong, nothing is imported.
guests.importFailed: Nothing was imported. Fix these rows and try again:

cover.hint: Shown on the opening screen and at the top of the invitation. JPEG, PNG or WebP, max. 15 MB.

qris.title: QRIS image
qris.hint: For the digital gift: guests scan this QRIS and pay you directly.
